title: 第7章 狠狠报复第8章 曾经怎样现在怎样
slug: 寡村寡事第446章后山的驴
content_zh:
这些人都等着看热闹呢。
“死垃圾！我呸！你也配和我打？”吴坤嘲笑，直接朝柳大春冲了过来！
这吴坤是练过的，冲击过来，对着柳大春就是一拳头。
这一拳质量很高，力道很猛。
看得出来，是练过的，这一拳击中，只怕是要吃大苦头，严重的，搞不好直接就进医院了。
边上两个村民眼里，那柳大春只怕是非死即残了！
可是眼看这拳头就要击中柳大春的脸，这时，柳大春的头稍稍一偏，似乎早就知道这一拳会从这个方向揍来一样。
紧接着，柳大春的膝盖往上用力一提，直接击中吴坤的下巴。
吴坤整个人被踢飞了起来，柳大春顺势一脚直踢，踢中吴坤的小腹，吴坤整个人就往后滚了下去，翻了好几个跟头，从梯田上直接就掉下去了。
当即倒在地上痛苦不堪！
那嫂子和两个村民都看呆了！简直不敢相信！
这傻子不是瘸子吗？
不是脑瘫吗？
不是个病秧子吗？
怎么会瞬间把吴坤给秒杀了？？
这几乎是不可能的事，这小子是吃了什么呀？
大力丸吗？
嫂子郑秋秋都有点看慌了。
更震惊的还是吴坤自己了，这傻大春怎么突然这么厉害？
痛死我了！

柳大春心里不解气，这个吴坤下毒害自己，嘴巴还那么贱，怎么可能让他这么舒服？
柳大春跳了下去，再次走到吴坤面前，一脚踩在了吴坤的脸上。
“你嘴巴刚才不是很贱吗？我让你骂！”柳大春的鞋子就踩在吴坤的嘴巴上，不断踩着。
那吴坤的嘴都出血了。
这吴坤也不是好惹的种，岂能如此就认了？
强忍着痛，一把拽开了柳大春的腿，整个人朝柳大春扑了过来，死死抱住柳大春的腰，往下面蛮牛冲撞过去。
“妈地，我杀了你！”
柳大春连连后退，已无可退，再退下去，要摔下去了，此处梯田有三四米高呢！
柳大春用脚一把刹住，这吴坤的力气确实，但柳大春运气，灵气凝聚，一把将吴坤给抬了起来，一个转身，将吴坤给扔了出去。
吴坤撞在石壁上，这次伤更重了。
柳大春走了过去，一巴掌拍了过去，嘴巴出血，牙都打掉了。
“你刚才不是嘴很碎吗？骂我死垃圾？你再骂一次试试？”
柳大春最讨厌这种骂人嘴碎的，没啥本事，自己垃圾不说，还要骂别人垃圾？？
哪来的理？哪来的优越感？
content_en:
These people are waiting to see the fun.
"Damn trash! Damn! Are you worthy of fighting me?" Wu Kun laughed and rushed towards Liu Dachun!
This Wu Kun had been trained, and when he came over, he punched Liu Dachun.
This punch was of high quality and very powerful.
It can be seen that he has been practicing. If he hits this punch, he will suffer a lot. If it is serious, he may go to the hospital directly.
In the eyes of the two villagers nearby, Liu Dachun was either dead or disabled!
But seeing that the fist was about to hit Liu Dachun's face, Liu Dachun's head tilted slightly, as if he had already known that the punch would come from this direction.
Immediately afterwards, Liu Dachun's knee lifted up hard and hit Wu Kun's chin directly.
Wu Kun was kicked into the air. Liu Dachun took advantage of the situation and kicked Wu Kun in the lower abdomen. Wu Kun rolled back, turned several somersaults, and fell directly from the terrace.
He immediately fell to the ground in agony!
The sister-in-law and the two villagers were stunned! I can't believe it!
Isn't this fool lame?
Not cerebral palsy?
Isn't he a sick man?
How could Wu Kun be killed instantly? ?
This is almost impossible. What did this kid eat?
Dali pill?
Sister-in-law Zheng Qiuqiu was a little panicked.
The one who was even more shocked was Wu Kun himself. How could this stupid Dachun be so powerful suddenly?
It hurts me to death!
Liu Dachun was puzzled. This Wu Kun poisoned himself and was so mean-mouthed. How could he be so comfortable?
Liu Dachun jumped down, walked up to Wu Kun again, and stepped on Wu Kun's face.
"Didn't your mouth sound mean just now? I asked you to scold me!" Liu Dachun's shoe stepped on Wu Kun's mouth, and kept stepping on it.
Wu Kun's mouth was bleeding.
This Wu Kun is not someone to be trifled with, how can he just accept it like this?
Holding back the pain, he pulled Liu Dachun's legs away, rushed towards Liu Dachun, hugged Liu Dachun's waist, and rushed towards the bull below.
"Damn it, I'll kill you!"
Liu Dachun kept retreating, and there was no way he could retreat. If he retreated any further, he would fall. The terraces here are three or four meters high!
Liu Dachun stopped Wu Kun with his feet. Wu Kun's strength was real, but Liu Dachun's luck and spiritual energy gathered him to lift Wu Kun up. He turned around and threw Wu Kun out.
Wu Kun hit the stone wall and was injured more seriously this time.
Liu Dachun walked over and slapped him, causing his mouth to bleed and his teeth to be knocked out.
"Weren't you very rude just now? You called me rubbish? Can you try calling me rubbish again?"
Liu Dachun hates this kind of scolding people the most. He has no ability. He doesn't say rubbish himself, but he still calls others rubbish? ?
Where does the logic come from? Where does the sense of superiority come from?
